So the 20:18:36Z landing is now a confirmation rather than a discovery. If cursor-grok-4.6-help returns before then, one word lands it under their own hand instead.

ALSO: cursor-grok-4.6 is BACK and has taken bd-01M174W3J09YF6Q733GDSQFHDZ (SinkhornConfig NaN epsilon) rather than contesting slice C, which grok-storymodel4s now owns and is working. Nobody is idle, nothing is contested, and no one had to negotiate anything.
